statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is the maximum of the set of all sums of the form sum_{i in S} nums[i], where S is any subset of {0, 1, ..., len(nums)-1} such that no two distinct indices in S are adjacent, i.e., for all i, j in S, |i - j| != 1. Equivalently, (a) there exists such an independent set S with sum_{i in S} nums[i] = r, and (b) for every independent set S, sum_{i in S} nums[i] <= r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 400.

statement: For every nums satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result r (it does not fail, panic, overflow, or access an out-of-bounds index).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 400.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r <= sum_{i=0}^{len(nums)-1} nums[i].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 400.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), r >= nums[i].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 400.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = nums[0].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 400, and len(nums) = 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = max(nums[0], nums[1]).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 400, and len(nums) = 2.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 0 if and only if for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] = 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 400.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = c * ((len(nums) + 1) / 2), where / denotes integer division (i.e., c * ceil(len(nums)/2)).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100, 0 <= nums[i] <= 400 for all i, and there exists c with 0 <= c <= 400 such that for every i, nums[i] = c.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every pair of indices i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums) and j >= i + 2, r >= nums[i] + nums[j].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 400.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, let E = sum of nums[i] over all even i with 0 <= i < len(nums), and O = sum of nums[i] over all odd i with 0 <= i < len(nums). Then r >= E and r >= O.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 400.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, there exists a subset S of {0, 1, ..., len(nums)-1} such that (i) S is independent (no two distinct elements of S are adjacent), (ii) sum_{i in S} nums[i] = r, and (iii) S is maximal independent, meaning that for every index i not in S there exists j in S with |i - j| = 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 400.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = 0, r is also the maximum of the set of sums sum_{j in S} nums[j] over all independent sets S that do not contain i (i.e., S is a subset of {0, ..., len(nums)-1} minus {i}).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 400.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = max(nums[0] + nums[2], nums[1]).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 400, and len(nums) = 3.
